title.zh: 形成的配准关系改变复制保真度

claim.zh: 对每个字母表与汲取律：在每一位接合配准所读之物的复制产生某词，当且仅当每一位读出该词的记号、池供给该词且支持覆盖其汲取，其产物只增长；对每个过程，每步延长输出当且仅当每段进程延长输出，每个非门控步保持的量沿每段非门控进程保持。配准机中，对每个状态，与词长相同数目的复制步把产物延长为该词，当且仅当每一位经实际连接读出其记号、池供给该词且支持覆盖其汲取；完整稳定配准恢复既有复制是其实例；每段进程使产物的边为其记号上的路径，所以完整配准复制模板（含边）当且仅当模板的边是该路径。缺接、错位与重接通过改变各位所读而改变后继；只有复制步改变产物，故连接变化不改写产物，每个允许的有限历史保留已成前缀及连接件、材料与支持的总量。消耗连接件和支持形成的配准接入材料复制。
claim.en: For every alphabet and law of draws: a copy attaching at each site what a registration reads there produces a word exactly when every site reads the word's token, the pool supplies the word and the support covers what it draws, and its product only grows; for every process an output is extended along every course exactly when every step extends it, and a quantity kept by every ungated step is kept along every ungated course. In the registration machine, for every state, as many copy moves as a word has tokens extend the product by that word exactly when each site reads its token through the actual contacts, the pool supplies it and the support covers what it draws; complete stable registration recovering prior copying is the instance; every course keeps the product's bonds the path on its tokens, so complete registration copies the template, bonds included, exactly when its bonds are that path. Loss, displacement and rebinding change the successor by changing what sites read; only copy moves change the product, so contact changes never rewrite it, and every admitted finite history keeps its built prefix and its totals of connectors, material and support. Connector- and support-consuming registration enters material copying.

hypotheses.zh: 索引位置与选择性对接、可靠取值、局部接合成本及事件发生给定；没有切除或替换已成产物的操作。
hypotheses.en: Indexed sites, selective docking, reliable transduction, local attachment costs and event occurrence are supplied; there is no excision or replacement of built material.

hypotheses.zh: 一般继承组合要求完整值配准、模板与前缀／剩余序列一致，且保留原定理的路径及材料／支持前提（非空前提不需要）。
hypotheses.en: The general inheritance composition requires complete value registration and template/prefix/suffix consistency, retaining the prior path and material/support premises (the nonempty premise is not needed).

correspondence.zh: 角色由共同活动中的对接、取值、移入与保留关系分化；配准为实际位置对，并非成功标签。局部辨别规律仍在等索引对接条件中给定。
correspondence.en: Roles differentiate through docking, reading, transfers and retention in common activity; registration consists of actual position pairs, not a success flag. Local discrimination remains supplied by the equal-index docking guard.

detail.zh: registered_operation_refines 将注册后的运行对应到旧步骤；registered_inheritance 实际调用 copied_structure_inherits。
detail.en: registered_operation_refines relates registered execution to the old steps; registered_inheritance directly uses copied_structure_inherits.

output.zh: 旧逐项复制在非空路径与明确供给下形成同结构后继。
output.en: The old tokenwise copying process forms an identical daughter under its nonempty-path and declared-supply conditions.

input.zh: 新过程的工作投影经完整配准及顺序一致性对应到旧复制。
input.en: The new work projection refines the old copying process under complete registration and order consistency.

conditions.zh: 连接在所比较的连续复制操作中保持；损失／错位的混合历史不自动满足。
conditions.en: Contacts remain stable during the compared copying operations; mixed histories with loss/displacement need not qualify.

detail.zh: 缺接可在有材料和支持时停滞；连接错位未必改值，重接不追改旧产物，连接数和全部复制状态相同仍可产出不同序列。
detail.en: Missing contacts stall despite stock/support; displacement need not change the value, rebinding does not rewrite old output, and matched contact counts/full copying state can produce different sequences.

limitations.zh: 未导出索引识别／取值规律、损伤率、纠错启动、切除机制、自供或种群选择；同等接触机制的强对手具有相同解释能力。
limitations.en: Indexed recognition/transduction, damage rates, repair initiation, excision, autonomous provision and population selection are not derived; a strong rival retaining the same contact mechanism has the same explanatory capacity.

validation_scope.zh: 33项新定理声明／54项新审计，484项实际闭包审计中430项继承分列；原始论文作为既有比较重读，无新经验复算。一般律仅经scratch实编。
validation_scope.en: 33 new theorem declarations / 54 new audits, with 430 inherited declarations separate in 484 actual-closure audits. The original paper is reread as the existing comparator, without new empirical reanalysis. General laws: scratch builds only.

next_delta.zh: formed-copying-correction 已接通已成产物的编辑与后继；继续参考关系的取得／更新、故障定位、支持再生及明确共同分配。
next_delta.en: formed-copying-correction now joins editing of an existing product and its successor; continue acquisition/renewal of the reference relation, fault localization, support renewal and explicit shared allocation.

history.zh: 2026-10-09：在既有分割研究中新增一个形成—读取—继承组合；保留旧理想复制、材料记录及社会组织支线的范围。
history.en: 2026-10-09: adds one formation–reading–inheritance composition in the existing fragmentation study; preserves ideal copying, material recording and social-organizational work at their scopes.

history.zh: 2026-10-09：已阅读同一研究新增的材料编辑连接；本记录的旧数学及原回执不变，旧无编辑范围不因新增操作而撤销。
history.en: 2026-10-09: reconciles the same study’s added material-editing connection; prior mathematics and receipts remain unchanged, and adding an editing operation does not withdraw the old no-editing scope.

history.zh: 2026-10-14：按旧记录一般律审计，主张改为一般律先行（新核心模块 Becoming.Copying 的读取律与延长律，及 Becoming.Gated）：外围 CopyingInstances 对每个配准状态给出经实际连接读取的等价，registered_inheritance 的产物记号是实例（不需非空路径前提），只有复制步改变产物，history_accounts 是空门的实例。scratch_build 实编；回执由落地运行绑定。原定理、回执与反例不变。
history.en: 2026-10-14: under the general-law audit of older records, the claim now states the law first (the reading and extension laws of the new core module Becoming.Copying, with Becoming.Gated): the periphery CopyingInstances gives the equivalence for reading through the actual contacts for every registration state; the product tokens of registered_inheritance are an instance (without the nonempty-path premise); only copy moves change the product; history_accounts is the instance with no move gated. Built with scratch_build; the landing run binds the receipt. The original theorems, receipt and counterexamples are unchanged.

history.zh: 2026-10-14，一般规律计划第三批（研究第114–115节）：审读以下改动后重新绑定：BECOMING-RENEWAL-READING.md（末尾新增两节（生存核、计数与持续的一般律；复制与回溯读出的一般律）及其英文段，并为第113–115节加注落地日期与回执；此前各节不变）。一般律现已绑定：Becoming.Copying 由核心回执 20261014T044840.291323Z；CopyingInstances 由外围回执 20261014T045347.438672Z；核心公理报告为空，外围只用标准公理。有效范围中关于一般律的说明改为回执已绑定。
history.en: 14 October 2026, batch 3 of the general-laws plan (study sections 114–115): reconciled after reading the changes to BECOMING-RENEWAL-READING.md (two sections appended, on the general laws of viability, countdown and lasting and on those of copying and retrodiction, with their English paragraphs, and dated landing notes for sections 113–115; earlier sections unchanged). The general laws are now bound: Becoming.Copying by core receipt 20261014T044840.291323Z; CopyingInstances by peripheral receipt 20261014T045347.438672Z; core axiom reports empty, peripheries with standard axioms only. The validation scope's note on the general laws now says the receipts are bound.

history.zh: 2026-10-14，开放问题计划（研究第116节）：registered_copy_cells 扩展到链的边：每段进程使产物的边为其记号上的路径（path_shaped_along，Countdown.invariant_iff_reach 的实例），所以完整配准复制模板（含边）恰当模板的边是该路径（registered_copy_iff）；边无需记号以外的条件，旧 registered_inheritance 是实例，不需其非空前提（registered_inheritance_instance）。Copying.lean 与 CopyingInstances.lean 改动后，第三批核验文件对它们的绑定已移去（核验文件的引用保留），有效范围中一般律的说明改为仅经scratch实编；落地时绑定新的核验文件。另审读改动后对齐研究的哈希（末尾新增第116节及其英文段；其余不变）。
history.en: 14 October 2026, open-issues plan (study section 116): registered_copy_cells is extended to the chain's bonds: every course keeps the product's bonds the path on its tokens (path_shaped_along, an instance of Countdown.invariant_iff_reach), so complete registration copies the template, bonds included, exactly when its bonds are that path (registered_copy_iff); the bonds need nothing beyond the tokens, and the old registered_inheritance is the instance without its nonempty premise (registered_inheritance_instance). With Copying.lean and CopyingInstances.lean changed, their batch-3 bindings were removed (the referenced verification files stay) and the validation scope's note on the general laws now says scratch builds only; the landing run binds the new verification files. The hash of the study was reconciled after reading its change (section 116 and its English paragraph appended; the rest unchanged).
